# Swarm_Adaptive_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network topology that reconfigures itself based on collective swarm intelligence, optimizing connectivity and resource usage in real time. Enables TCC to handle dynamic workloads and failures by self-healing and re-routing, critical for high-performance interconnect fabrics.
